summary.text: You can enrol only with a participating clinic. You may keep visiting your current GP, but Healthier SG benefits will not apply there.

details.heading: Keep visiting your current GP
details.body: You may continue to visit a non-Healthier SG clinic after enrolling. Healthier SG benefits will not apply there; you would only be able to enjoy existing schemes such as CHAS and MediSave.

steps.name: Choose a participating clinic
steps.text: Choose a Healthier SG clinic in HealthHub to enrol and access Healthier SG benefits.

items: You can enrol only with a clinic that is participating in Healthier SG.
Choose from the Healthier SG clinics in HealthHub to access Healthier SG benefits.

steps.name: Ask your GP to join
steps.text: If your current GP is not a Healthier SG clinic, you could encourage your GP to join.

items: If your current GP is not on Healthier SG, you could encourage your GP to onboard Healthier SG.

sources.page_title: Why can't I find my Healthier SG clinic of choice? What do I do if my existing General Practitioner (GP) is not a Healthier SG clinic?

quotes.text: For Healthier SG, residents can enrol only with a clinic that is participating in Healthier SG.
For Healthier SG, residents can enrol only with a clinic that is participating in Healthier SG. GP clinics that are not Healthier SG will not be available for selection.
If your current GP is not on Healthier SG, you could also encourage your GP to onboard Healthier SG.

You may continue to visit non-Healthier SG clinics even after your enrolment. However, Healthier SG benefits will not be applicable at clinics that you are not enrolled with, so you would only be able to enjoy the existing schemes such as CHAS and MediSave.
